scenarios.user: An agent or maintainer new to GTM work
scenarios.goal: Find where the daily records and credentials are and what each source needs
scenarios.prerequisites: A checkout of the repository; no private files
steps: Open AGENTS.md and follow the go-to-market row to gtm/README.md
Read the location table, the bucket section and the per-source access table
scenarios.expected: The reader knows the bucket, the private directory and its files, the variables and the permission each source relies on, without any secret value
scenarios.failure: A link is broken or a source has no stated location: the artifact checker fails, or the document review records the gap

scenarios.goal: Be stopped before private records or a broken GTM link reach a commit
steps: Force-add a file under gtm/data/ and run python3 scripts/check-artifact-policy.py --staged
Stage a gtm document with a link to a missing file and run the checker again
scenarios.expected: Both runs exit non-zero and name the offending path; a normal git add does not stage gtm/data/ because it is ignored
scenarios.failure: The checker accepts either case: the regression tests fail

scenarios.user: A reviewer of the pull request
scenarios.goal: Confirm that the public change discloses no private value
scenarios.prerequisites: The outgoing commits and the private variable file on the author's machine
steps: Scan the outgoing diff for the private values and for key, token and identifier patterns
Read gtm/sources.md and gtm/log.md for figures or identifiers
scenarios.expected: No credential, account identifier, download count, ad statistic or review body appears; only public store values with dates
scenarios.failure: A match is found: the value is removed before push and the scan is repeated

scenarios.user: The Hermes workspace setting up the collection host
scenarios.goal: Confirm that every source answers with the copied credentials before building collectors
scenarios.prerequisites: The private GTM files copied to a mode-700 directory on the host, paths in gtm.env rewritten, Node and the AWS CLI installed
steps: Fix every line that does not read ok and run it again
scenarios.expected: Seven lines read ok and the exit code is 0; no configured value appears in the output
scenarios.failure: A refused or not configured line names the source and a fixed reason; the exit code is 1
